title: Upper bound for the normal-part integral by slope, mass off the graph, and tilt
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers and mu a measure on R^(n+l). Let p : R^(n+l) -> L(R^(n+l)) be a mu-a.e. strongly measurable field of continuous linear maps with ||p(x)|| <= 1 for all x. Let T be a linear subspace of R^(n+l) with orthogonal projection P = T.starProjection, F a measurable subset of R^(n+l), zeta in R^(n+l), s > 0 and eps real. Write B := B_{3s}(zeta) (closed ball), and assume mu(B) < infinity and |(x - zeta) - P(x - zeta)| <= eps |x - zeta| for every x in F. Then the Bochner integral over B of |(x - zeta) - p(x)(x - zeta)|^2 dmu is at most 18 s^2 [ eps^2 mu(B) + mu(B minus F) + the Bochner integral over B of hsNormSq(p(x) - P) dmu ], with the masses taken as real numbers (toReal).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (p : Amb n ℓ → (Amb n ℓ →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ)) (T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)) (F : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (ζ : Amb n ℓ) (s ε : ℝ), 0 < s → AEStronglyMeasurable p μ → (∀ x, ‖p x‖ ≤ 1) → MeasurableSet F → μ (closedBall ζ (3 * s)) ≠ ⊤ → (∀ x ∈ F, ‖(x - ζ) - T.starProjection (x - ζ)‖ ≤ ε * ‖x - ζ‖) → ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s), ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ 18 * s ^ 2 * (ε ^ 2 * (μ (closedBall ζ (3 * s))).toReal + (μ (closedBall ζ (3 * s) \ F)).toReal + ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s), hsNormSq (p x - T.starProjection) ∂μ)
